The '''Outrider''' was a [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that served in the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The ''Outrider'' was captained by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Hardin (captain)|Hardin]], and had a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] navigator named [[Tarev]] and a Human communications officer named [[Sola (Outrider)|Sola]]. The ship was assigned by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] to investigate [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] military activity in the [[Vyron system/Legends|Vyron system]], and it then ferried Saresh's strike team to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="Karagga" />
